_comment: mutationProbability is the chance that an offspring undergoes ONE mutation event (see Genetics.Inheritance).

traits.name: Body size
traits.description: Maps linearly to the species' body size range; larger bodies move faster but burn more energy.

traits.name: Marking density
traits.description: How many spots or bands the body carries.

traits.name: Hue shift
traits.description: Shifts the body colour around the colour wheel (0.5 = species typical).

traits.name: Pattern contrast
traits.description: Contrast between base colour and markings.

traits.name: Appendage length
traits.description: Relative length of antennae, tail or fins.

traits.name: Metabolic efficiency
traits.description: Higher values lower basal energy use (±15 %).
